Dev logins and defaults

Every development default in this repository, where it is set, and whether to change it for production. tools/logins/check.js (run by make validate) fails when a port, account, password, token or key appears in code or configuration without a row here.

Accounts

There are none. Soundboard 0.1.0 has no server, no sign-in and no seeded accounts. When sync ships, seeded accounts will follow <role>@soundboard.station.center with password demo-placeholder-password, and be listed here.

Defaults

DefaultValueSet inChange for production
Docs site port8052Makefile (SITE_PORT), tools/site/serve.mjs, deploy/compose.yamlNo: local preview only
Apple bundle ID prefixcom.soundboardplatforms/apple/project.yml (bundleIdPrefix)Yes, to the owner's registered identifier
Apple app bundle IDcom.soundboard.appplatforms/apple/project.ymlYes, with the prefix
Apple signing teamNot setXcode › Signing & Capabilities (per machine)Set by whoever signs a release
Android application IDcom.soundboard.routinglabplatforms/android/app/build.gradle.ktsYes, before any store build
Android debug keystore~/.android/debug.keystore, store and key password android, alias androiddebugkeyCreated by the Android SDK on first debug buildNever ship with it; release signing uses a private keystore outside the repository
Engine sample rate fallback48000 Hzplatforms/apple/Sources/SoundboardUI/Model/DJSession.swift, RoutingLabModel.swiftNo: used only when the device reports none

Secrets, tokens, API keys, buckets, client IDs

None. Nothing in the repository authenticates to anything. .env.example does not exist because no setting comes from the environment.

Source: docs/guides/dev-logins.md
